Metod

  • Tempo ekipe: procjena kroz FGA + 0.44 × FTA - OREB + TOV, blended with opponent possessions where available.
  • Next-five težina: uses opponent pace, PIR allowed, points allowed, FGA allowed and rebounds allowed. Lower FDR is easier.
  • Option score: combines projected PIR, value, minutes, shooting usage, price gap, form, schedule and risk penalties.
  • Kompletna statistika: includes all 81 columns currently generated by the model, not only the short decision view.
  • Udio šuteva: FGA/G igrača podijeljen sa FGA/G tima, samo current-season EuroLeague šutevi. Primjer: 5 šuteva igrača i 10 šuteva tima = 50%.

Sve metrike su model procjene i treba da pomognu, ne da zamijene tvoju fantasy procjenu.
